OperationID.description: Client-chosen ID for this write (8–64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9-]). Generated by the server when absent; echoed in the response header. Reusing an ID returns 409 with duplicate_operation: true.
OperationID.name: X-Operation-ID

password.description: Samba password; must not contain newlines

fingerprint.description: OpenSSH SHA256 fingerprint (as printed by ssh-keygen -l); empty if the line could not be parsed

type.description: Key type, e.g. ssh-ed25519; empty if the line could not be parsed

gid.description: Numeric GID; empty lets the OS choose

compression.description: Root dataset compression; empty for the default

dataset.description: Dataset whose mountpoint becomes the path (used when path is empty)

path.description: Share path; required unless dataset is given

create_group.description: Create the primary group (named after the user unless group is set)

password.description: Plaintext password; must not contain newlines

smb_user.description: Also register the user with Samba

uid.description: Numeric UID; empty lets the OS choose

imported.description: Targets imported from the existing ctl.conf

skipped.description: ctl.conf entries dumpstore cannot represent (kept in the backup)

backend.description: linux (targetcli), freebsd (ctld), or empty when no backend is installed

members.description: Comma-separated member list; replaces the current members (empty clears them)

move_home.description: Move the contents of the old home directory to the new one

password.description: Plaintext password; must not contain newlines

smb_sync.description: Also update the user's Samba password

new_name.description: New name; must share the parent dataset

job_id.description: Background job carrying the transfer; poll GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}

skip_clone_shared.description: zfs rewrite -C: skip blocks shared with clones

conf_mtime.description: smb.conf modification time (RFC 3339, UTC); absent if the file does not exist

wsdd.description: Absent if smb.conf cannot be parsed

key.description: Public key line, e.g. ssh-ed25519 AAAA... comment

available.description: false if Samba is not available; users is then empty

threshold_days.description: FreeBSD periodic(8): scrub when the last scrub is older than this many days (default 35). Ignored on Linux.

incremental_from.description: Earlier snapshot for an incremental send

remote.description: user@host to receive over SSH; omit for a local receive

target.description: Receiving dataset, prefixed with remote: for SSH sends

recursive.description: Apply to all files below the mountpoint

dataset.description: Dataset whose mountpoint + /%U becomes the path (used when path is empty)

path.description: Share path; required unless dataset is given

to.description: Empty when diffing against the live filesystem

truncated.description: True when the diff was cut at 10000 entries

shares.description: All Time Machine shares after the change

version.description: OpenZFS version; empty when it cannot be determined

conf_path.description: Options file dumpstore renders; empty on FreeBSD and for units that do not read $WSDD_PARAMS

install_hint.description: Package-manager command to install wsdd (only when not installed)

proxyUser.description: Authenticated user asserted by a reverse proxy; honoured only from the configured trusted proxy CIDRs.
proxyUser.name: X-Remote-User

info.description: HTTP API of dumpstore, a web UI for ZFS and file sharing. Generated from the server's route registry (internal/apispec). Dataset, snapshot and device names contain '/' and '@' — percent-encode them in path parameters. Every write accepts an optional X-Operation-ID header; its progress steps are published on the ansible.progress SSE topic and the result can be fetched from GET /api/v1/operations/{id}.
